title: The rulings gate and dehydration collide: a ratified ruling cites a thread file that a done thread's unlisting takes off the disk
body:
Found twice on 2026-09-12: a ratified ruling cites a thread file as its record, `rulings_check.sh` resolves the record on disk, and a completed thread hv's hygiene rule unlists takes its file off the disk. ST0058 and ST0066 stay realised until the gate resolves a dehydrated thread's record through the canon extract, or the two records cite canon paths. Small, code, hv's to rule. Carried in `intent/wip.md` until 2026-09-13.

CLOSED 2026-09-14 19:02Z: rulings_check.sh now resolves a ruling whose record names a thread file through that thread's canon when the file is not on disk: a generated view (info.md, acceptance.md, a work package's info.md) resolves when the thread's canon exists, since the view renders from it, and an attachment resolves when the canon lists it. A record on disk resolves as before, and a thread file the canon does not carry still dangles. So a completed thread no longer has to stay realised for the gate's sake; ST0058 and ST0066, whose acceptance.md are the two such records, are unlisted in their own commit after this one (vc's ruling). Fixed in the commit that closes this issue.
